comparison.objective: Slide a stir bar into a tilted flask; the candidate mechanically configures a gripper.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-object alignment and insertion through a vessel mouth under gravity, not nut-and-screw countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Stir bar must enter and remain in the flask without loss or damage; the body lacks a full numeric rubric.
comparison.reason: Insertion into a vessel tests a different ability from locking an adjustable stop.
